title: QA Engineer  CIVIL
description:
We are looking for an experienced QA Engineer – Civil with hands-on exposure to grouting, ground improvement and geotechnical construction works. The candidate will be responsible for quality monitoring, site inspections, testing.Monitor QA/QC activities at project sites.
Inspect and monitor grouting and ground improvement works.
Coordinate quality activities for D-Wall and Cut-Off Wall works.
Monitor TAM Grouting.

Key Skills: Diaphragm Wall (D-Wall),Cut-Off Wall,TAM Grouting,Grouting,Ground Improvement,Jet Grouting,QA/QC,Geotechnical Investigation Works
